meta.title: Cognos — AI you can tell anything
meta.description: Most AI keeps what you type and trains on it. Cognos doesn't. We keep no copy of your chats we can read, your personal details are hidden before your message is sent, and the AI forgets your chat the moment it answers. Handled in Switzerland or Europe.

hero.lead: Every other AI keeps what you type — and uses it to train its next model. Your health. Your money. Your worries. All sitting on someone else's computer. Cognos works the other way round. We keep no copy of your chats we can read. Your personal details are hidden before anything is sent. And the AI forgets your chat the moment it answers.
hero.finehint: From CHF 15/month · 60-day money-back guarantee · Handled in Switzerland or Europe

how.title: Privacy isn't a setting here. It's how it's built.
how.lead: Four things happen every time you hit send — automatically, without you lifting a finger.

steps.title: 1 · Your details get hidden
steps.body: Things like your email, bank details and ID are swapped for placeholders — before your message ever leaves your screen.

steps.title: 2 · The AI answers, then forgets
steps.body: Your message goes to a trusted AI in Switzerland or Europe. It replies, and keeps nothing.

steps.title: 3 · Your chat gets locked away
steps.body: We save your conversation in a form we can't read. No readable copy is ever kept.

steps.title: 4 · Only you hold the key
steps.body: Your chats open with your key — a private key only you have. Your password just signs you in.

features.title: Privacy you can actually see
features.lead: Simple controls that keep your life your own.

items.title: Nothing readable is kept
items.body: We save your chats in a form we can't read — so there's nothing to leak, sell, or hand over.

items.title: Your details, hidden automatically
items.body: Emails, bank details, ID numbers and passwords are hidden before your message is sent. On by default.

items.title: You pick where it's handled
items.body: Keep everything in Switzerland, or open up to Europe for more AI models to choose from.

items.title: Messages that delete themselves
items.body: Set a timer and your chat disappears — from your device and from us. Gone means gone.

items.title: Incognito mode
items.body: Start a chat that's never saved. Close it, and there's nothing left behind.

items.title: Your key, your data
items.body: Only your key opens your chats. Forgot your password? Reset it — your chats stay safe.
